name: flowcraft-studio-android
description: Android shell for the FlowCraft Studio web UI (Capacitor).

scripts.sync: npm run copy-web && npx cap sync android && node scripts/apply-branding.mjs
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
